meta_description:
3,835 likes, 13 comments - casarthakahuja on October 11, 2026: "The caffeine in your Diet Coke and Red Bull is a white powder controlled by one company...

And 80% of the caffeine that you consume through such beverages in India is supplied by this one company...

I’ll explain how this business works...

So while there is naturally occurring caffeine that you get from your coffee and tea... caffeine in other energy drinks is added artificially as synthetic chemical...

This is a white powder called caffeine anhydrous, which means without the water...

These compounds are called Xanthines, where caffeine is a derivative or subset of Xanthines... and currently China occupies 70% of the global supply for it...

But in 2026, China has removed a rebate that it used to give its caffeine exporters, which means those from other parts of the world may benefit...

Now, as per estimates, the next largest player outside of China is an Indian company that has approximately 15% global market share...

And it makes this caffeine in Tarapur in Maharashtra...

This company is called Aarti Pharmalabs...

The China + 1 strategy seems so real that in the past five years, this company’s stock has gone up from Rs 250 to Rs 850, which means almost 3.5X in 5 years, and a 27% p.a. CAGR...

This is not to say you should invest or not invest in this company... but to tell you how the energy drinks market is growing so rapidly right now globally ...

And real monopolies are sitting not in replicating a US product in India, but in looking at such companies in industrial ingredients and see how you can fit into the supply chain...

Because when the world runs after gold, it makes better sense to sell shovels.

#casarthakahuja".
